gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Bold and expressive up top, then a quieter body below. Revalia swaggers with its open-curled g and wide-striding letters, while Noto Sans Duployan simply gets on with clear text, its wide-mouthed a and big counters doing the work.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Revalia strides along with a tall band of widely spaced letters and an open-tailed g. And Noto Sans Elbasan follows in large, plain forms with terminals that never pinch shut, so a long passage goes down easily.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: An open-tailed g and widely spaced, tall letters give Revalia its relaxed swagger. And Noto Sans Elymaic answers with open apertures and ascenders hugging the x-height, which is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Loud letters, loose stride. Revalia leads with an open-tailed g, while Noto Sans Kaithi fills each line with capital-sized lowercase and open-channeled e's, and that stature is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Revalia takes its time, spacing its tall lettering widely and ending the g in an open curve. Noto Sans Kayah Li then reads smoothly, with lifted brush ends and capitals barely above the lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Big, loose, a bit theatrical: Revalia spreads its tall letters wide and leaves the g open at the bottom. Noto Sans Khmer sits beside it, proud small letters with chisel-notch openings, steady against the show.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Loud, loose and wide-striding. Revalia hangs an open-curved g under its tall letters, and Noto Sans Khojki lets light through its wide exits and gives every e a large clear eye.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha has the stature of cast iron capitals in its lowercase. Revalia's widely separated, tall letters and open-tailed g take the lead, while this body keeps its curves wide open underneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu keeps tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line, and its s curves open wide. Under Revalia's relaxed, widely spaced heading, it reads smoothly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Revalia's open-tailed g and wide, relaxed stride are hard to miss. Beside it, Noto Sans Lydian looks approachable, with capitals barely taller than lowercase and openings as wide as a sprung paper clip.
